name: futures-trading-harness
description: LLM-agnostic futures trading harness through any broker MCP server: strategies as Markdown, parallel analyst/risk/executor/reviewer roles, workflow skills, and a fail-closed order gate.

hooks_enabled.title: Enable trading harness hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run the order gate, session briefing, and review reminder. Turning this off removes the harness discipline layer; the broker MCP server guardrails still apply.

hook_profile.title: Hook profile
hook_profile.description: minimal, standard, or strict. The order gate and briefing run in every profile; the review reminder runs in standard and strict.
